description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1+2 tek kompleksi SIRI ne rrugen Siri Kodra .
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje pallati te ri me ashensor e te mireadministruar .
Apartamenti organizohet nga nje soxhorno e madhe bashke me kendin e gatimit , 2 dhoma gjumi , 2 tualete dhe 1 ballkon .
Apartamenti eshte i shtruar me parket , ka sistem kondicionimi multi - split , vetrata plastike dopio xham , tualeti incaso, izolim akustik, fasade e ventiluar.
Apartamenti eshte i pajisur me te gjitha elektroshtepiaket e nevojshme te cilat jane te markave te njohura ne treg .
Te gjitha dritaret dhe ballkoni jane te pajisura me grila.
Apartamenti eshte pjese e nje prej komplekseve me te mira te zones ,
Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor .
Per me shume informacion na kontaktonii .
title_en: Apartment 2+1+2 for sale at Siri Complex
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale in the SIRI complex on Siri Kodra street. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment is organized by a large living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 1 balcony. The apartment is laid with parquet, has a multi-split air conditioning system, double-glazed plastic windows, incaso toilet, acoustic insulation, ventilated facade. The apartment is equipped with all the necessary household appliances, which are of well-known brands in the market. All windows and balconies are equipped with shutters. The apartment is part of one of the best complexes in the area, the apartment has regular mortgage documentation. For more information, contact us.
